name: obscurify
description: Privacy-focused, OpenAI-compatible API to 200+ models (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, GPT, Claude, Gemini and more) over zero-data-retention routes, with anonymous account-number sign-up
setup_steps: Create an account at https://obscurify.ai (a random account number, no email)
Add a balance on the account page (the API works on every plan with a positive balance)
Open https://obscurify.ai/account and click Show API Key
Paste the sk-obs1_... key above as OBSCURIFY_API_KEY
